items.text: Refined ladder movement and contacts for smoother climbing
Extended monument ladders and fixed water entry issues
Fixed train tunnel entrances spawning incorrectly, prevented stations from leading to void, and corrected above‑ground ramp connections
Door controllers no longer become unpaired after a door is re‑skinned
Tooltips no longer shift position based on FPS
Settings dropdowns stay closed when dismissed
Recycling Bin now correctly swaps items instead of showing an error message
Fixed catapult projectiles clipping off the map, restoring proper projectile behavior.
Added new scout drone mechanics: 4‑second wind‑up beeps, dodgeable charges, 55 damage blasts, and mid‑fight strike capability.
Resolved invisible building block bug, ensuring all placed structures are visible to players.

Major extraction mission overhaul: added CZ‑721 backstory and optional conversations, refined hold‑E mission interactions (movement/camera lock, progress tracking, material consumption after completion), introduced loot reveal and first loot item spawn, extended mission card UI, and preserved safe‑pocket items during load.
Raids now require a valid raid map to start, preventing crashes when a map is missing.
Adjusted loot pricing to reflect item type, gave furniture its own inventory contents, and added weight to blueprints.
Added progress indicators to hotbar actions, giving players visual feedback on action cooldowns and reloads.
Each enemy type now grants its own specific reward, including monument guards.
Scout drones have been added: they patrol small monuments, emit a visible light, can search for players, and have health as a nuisance.
Monument guards are tiered; weaker factions now fall under scientists, and guard loot scales by tier.
Outpost is removed from the main raid map but placed on the extraction map, which now features more monuments and a new 3 km procedural scene.
Extraction balloons are now marked on the map with a countdown timer and close sequentially.
The main inventory size on the extraction map has been halved.
Safe pocket items are now counted as carried, and the map is cleared after each raid.
Extracted loot is automatically banked in a stash, and raiders are dropped in at raid start.
Supplies shop now pays more, values every item, and loot drops above crafted gear.
All items now have a scrap value displayed, letting players see loot worth at a glance.
A reload bar is shown next to the weapon in the shoulder camera.
Safe pocket amount is displayed beside any item being looted.
Players can no longer deploy structures while crafting.
Turn‑in‑place rotation bug causing visual pops in first‑person view has been fixed.
Heavy NPCs no longer drop the client upon death.

2026-11-16.summary: No notable player-facing changes were identified in the latest development commits.

items.text: Mission interactions refined: hold‑E actions now lock movement and camera and cancel cleanly; ledger and maintenance‑log reads take 5 seconds and only consume repair materials after completion; safe‑pocket items are preserved when loading before the backpack.
Scout drones now perform exterior searches with a 4‑second wind‑up, fire dodgeable 55‑damage charges, and can strike mid‑fight.
Starting a raid without a raid map now simply fails instead of causing an error, preventing crashes.
A new apartment‑complex caretaker NPC patrols the building at night, knocks on rented doors and looks through a peephole.
Mission loot is now revealed to players when earned, and the first loot item appears in inventory without hot‑bar outlines for clearer view.

2026-11-15.summary:

- Mission interactions refined: hold‑E actions now lock movement and camera and cancel cleanly; ledger and maintenance‑log reads take 5 seconds and only consume repair materials after completion; safe‑pocket items are preserved when loading before the backpack.

### Drones
- Scout drones now perform exterior searches with a 4‑second wind‑up, fire dodgeable 55‑damage charges, and can strike mid‑fight.

### Raiding
- Starting a raid without a raid map now simply fails instead of causing an error, preventing crashes.

### NPC & AI
- A new apartment‑complex caretaker NPC patrols the building at night, knocks on rented doors and looks through a peephole.

### Loot & UI
- Mission loot is now revealed to players when earned, and the first loot item appears in inventory without hot‑bar outlines for clearer view.
